name: Dundee City
title: Dundee —
tagline: The city of discovery, with Scotland's design museum on the Tay.
summary: Dundee grew in the 19th century on jute, jam and journalism, and built the polar ship Discovery. Today it is known for the V&A Dundee, universities and video game industry.
The waterfront has been rebuilt in recent years, and the Law hill gives a view over the Tay estuary.

community.intro: Dundonians emigrated widely, and Dundee-born families are found across Canada, Australia and the US.

ancestry: Searching for your family's roots? ScotlandsPeople, the Scottish Government's genealogy service, holds statutory registers of births, marriages and deaths, census returns and Old Parish Registers.
